## Products

Open source products developed, maintained and commercially supported by Sekoya.

- [LibreDB Studio](https://libredb.org): The modern, AI-powered open source SQL IDE for cloud-native teams. MIT-licensed, web-based, covering PostgreSQL, MySQL, Oracle, SQL Server, SQLite, MongoDB and Redis. Monaco editor, interactive ER diagrams, schema diff and migration, multi-model AI copilot (Gemini, OpenAI, Claude, or local models via Ollama/LM Studio), OIDC SSO with PKCE, RBAC, query auditing, and a DBA monitoring toolkit. Distributed via Docker, Helm (HTTP repo and OCI on GHCR), npx, Homebrew, deb/rpm, Snap, winget, Chocolatey, and native desktop builds; one-click deploy on DigitalOcean Marketplace, Koyeb, Render, Railway, CapRover, Fly.io, Dokploy and Cosmos. Validated on Rancher-managed RKE2 and K3s; SUSE Ready for Rancher certification in progress.
- [LibreDB Studio case study](https://sekoya.tech/portfolio/libredb-studio/): Product overview, feature set, distribution channels, Kubernetes/Rancher support, and engineering practice
- [LibreDB Studio source](https://github.com/libredb/libredb-studio): GitHub repository
- [LibreDB](https://github.com/libredb/libredb-database): A small, readable, embeddable multi-model database in TypeScript. MIT-licensed, zero runtime dependencies, ESM-only, under 6 kB min+brotli. One ordered key-value core with key-value, document and relational lenses over it; in-memory or WAL-backed durable files; crash recovery proven by deterministic simulation testing with 100% core coverage. Published to npm (`@libredb/libredb`) and JSR, with a CLI, standalone binaries, and multi-arch container images on GHCR and Docker Hub. Currently an early beta aimed at test and development environments.
- [LibreDB case study](https://sekoya.tech/portfolio/libredb-database/): Architecture, durability contract, tooling, and documented v1 scope

## Services

- [Mobile & Web Application Development](https://sekoya.tech/services/mobile-web-development/): Native and cross-platform mobile apps (Flutter, React Native), responsive web applications, progressive web apps
- [Custom App Development](https://sekoya.tech/services/custom-app-development/): Tailored software solutions for specific business needs, enterprise applications, system integrations
- [Software Consultancy](https://sekoya.tech/services/software-consultancy/): Technical strategy, architecture review, technology stack advisory, code audit, and modernization planning
- [Project Management](https://sekoya.tech/services/project-management/): Agile/Scrum project management, delivery oversight, team coordination, and process optimization
- [IoT Solutions](https://sekoya.tech/services/iot-solutions/): Industrial IoT platforms, sensor integration, real-time monitoring dashboards, MQTT/edge computing
- [Machine Learning](https://sekoya.tech/services/machine-learning/): Predictive analytics, recommendation systems, data pipelines, ML model training and deployment
- [Artificial Intelligence](https://sekoya.tech/services/artificial-intelligence/): NLP, computer vision, generative AI integration, intelligent automation, AI-powered business solutions
- [DevOps & Cloud Services](https://sekoya.tech/services/devops-cloud/): CI/CD pipelines, cloud migration (AWS/Azure/GCP), Kubernetes, Docker, infrastructure as code, monitoring
